copy_leaders.title: Conservative Momentum Scout
copy_leaders.description: Entry-level bot for smaller portfolios. Scouts steady 24h momentum on BTC, ETH and majors, takes small positions with tight stop-losses and low leverage. Patient, selective, capital-preservation first.

copy_leaders.title: Gold & Commodity Swing Engine
copy_leaders.description: Specialist bot for the hard-asset aisle: PAX Gold, silver, oil and energy. Slower swing entries on gold/commodity momentum, wider targets, disciplined invalidation. Diversifies a crypto-heavy book.

copy_leaders.title: Compounding Machine (CMF Strategy)
copy_leaders.description: The platform’s flagship compounding engine — built from the Crypto Multiplier Framework. Rides confirmed trends across majors and mega-cap tech, compounds gains with structured position sizing and strict per-trade risk.

copy_leaders.title: Aggressive Momentum Bull
copy_leaders.description: High-velocity bot for large portfolios. Hunts explosive 24h movers with higher leverage and bigger size, taking profit fast. High reward, high drawdown — size your allocation accordingly.
